verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ingests traces, logs, and metrics and stores traces and logs as structured events that can be queried together. Its demo advertises correlating app and Kubernetes errors, which points to its own correlation capability. However, no evidence documents a direct jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics. Missing for 10: documented span-to-log navigation, span-to-metrics correlation, end-to-end request debugging workflow docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: traces and logs are stored as structured events... indexed automatically on every field at ingest, and queryable without a predefined schema.
